newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to ask US to quickly grant US phone licences.
newsitem.headline: Japan to ask US to quickly grant US phone licences.

text.p: Posts and Telecommunications Vice Minister Mitsuo Igarashi told a news conference on Thursday that Japan will ask the United States to quickly grant U.S. telephone licences to Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT).
Igarashi also said the apparent U.S. stance of linking the licensing issue with the bilateral trade issue was "hard to understand".

He said that the office of the U.S. Trade Representative asked the Japanese embassy in Washington on March 10 if the two countries could start talks on renewing NTT's overseas procurement agreement, which is set to expire in September.
The USTR also asked Japan to scrap the 20 percent ownership ceiling in NTT and KDD by the end of this year, Igarashi said.

KDD and NTT officials said on Wednesday that the the U.S. Federal Communications Commission had informed them earlier this month that the granting of U.S. licences to provide international phone services would be postponed.
